req.title: Include origin IP in echoed metadata
req.statement: The system shall include the client origin (X-Forwarded-For if present, else remote_addr) in the 'origin' field of all echo endpoints.
triggers: include origin ip in echoed metadata

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that all echo endpoints (/get, /post, /put, /patch, /delete) must include the client origin IP in the 'origin' field, preferring X-Forwarded-For if present, else falling back to remote_addr. The key logic is in get_dict() in helpers.py: `origin=request.headers.get('X-Forwarded-For', request.remote_addr)`. Tests must cover: (1) positive - remote_addr used when no X-Forwarded-For header; (2) positive - X-Forwarded-For header takes precedence; (3) negative - absence of origin key is caught; (4) boundary - X-Forwarded-For with multiple IPs (comma-separated chain); (5) decision table - all five endpoints return origin; (6) boundary - empty vs non-empty X-Forwarded-For. Mutation targets: the `get` vs `get('X-Forwarded-For', remote_addr)` fallback, the field name 'origin', and the header name string 'X-Forwarded-For'.

tests.name: test_get_origin_uses_remote_addr_when_no_xff
actions: Check 'origin' field equals the test client remote_addr (127.0.0.1)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-034: origin field must use remote_addr when X-Forwarded-For absent
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_get_origin_uses_remote_addr_when_no_xff():
    r = client.get('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert 'origin' in data
    assert data['origin'] == '127.0.0.1'

test_get_origin_uses_remote_addr_when_no_xff()

def test_get_origin_uses_xff_when_present():

    assert r.status_code == 200

    assert 'origin' in data
    assert data['origin'] == '203.0.113.42'

tests.name: test_origin_xff_multi_ip_chain_boundary
preconditions: X-Forwarded-For contains a comma-separated chain of IPs
actions: Assert origin equals the full header value (entire chain, not just first or last)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-034: origin must reflect X-Forwarded-For verbatim including proxy chain
BVA: boundary between single IP and multi-IP chain in X-Forwarded-For
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_origin_xff_multi_ip_chain_boundary():
    xff = '10.0.0.1, 172.16.0.1, 203.0.113.99'
    r = client.get('/get', headers={'X-Forwarded-For': xff})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert 'origin' in data
    assert data['origin'] == xff
    assert data['origin'] != '10.0.0.1'
    assert data['origin'] != '203.0.113.99'

test_origin_xff_multi_ip_chain_boundary()

tests.name: test_all_echo_endpoints_include_origin_field
preconditions: X-Forwarded-For set to a known IP
actions: Send GET /get, POST /post, PUT /put, PATCH /patch, DELETE /delete each with X-Forwarded-For: 198.51.100.7
Assert each response has status 200 and origin == '198.51.100.7'
trace: R-HTTPBIN-034: ALL echo endpoints must include origin
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_all_echo_endpoints_include_origin_field():
    xff = '198.51.100.7'
    headers = {'X-Forwarded-For': xff}
    endpoints = [
        ('GET', '/get'),
        ('POST', '/post'),
        ('PUT', '/put'),
        ('PATCH', '/patch'),
        ('DELETE', '/delete'),
    ]
    for method, path in endpoints:
        r = client.open(path, method=method, headers=headers)
        assert r.status_code == 200, f'{method} {path} status={r.status_code}'
        data = r.get_json()
        assert 'origin' in data, f'{method} {path} missing origin'
        assert data['origin'] == xff, f'{method} {path} origin={data["origin"]}'

test_all_echo_endpoints_include_origin_field()

tests.name: test_origin_field_name_is_exactly_origin
actions: Assert the key 'origin' exists in response JSON
trace: R-HTTPBIN-034: field must be named 'origin' exactly
BVA: catches mutation of the string constant 'origin' to another name
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_origin_field_name_is_exactly_origin():
    r = client.get('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert 'origin' in data
    assert 'Origin' not in data
    assert 'ORIGIN' not in data
    assert 'ip' not in data
    assert 'remote_addr' not in data
    assert data['origin'] == '127.0.0.1'

test_origin_field_name_is_exactly_origin()

from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_patch_and_put_origin_without_xff():
    r_patch = client.patch('/patch')
    assert r_patch.status_code == 200
    data_patch = r_patch.get_json()
    assert 'origin' in data_patch
    assert data_patch['origin'] == '127.0.0.1'

    r_put = client.put('/put')
    assert r_put.status_code == 200
    data_put = r_put.get_json()
    assert 'origin' in data_put
    assert data_put['origin'] == '127.0.0.1'
